_about: The Sessellift detachable grip (owner LM10), one design for every Sessellift detachable chair. Measured on the D6's 1:50 layouts (0.315 px per mm; five end-view copies overlaid to part grip from station, and both side views) and the owner's photos; millimetres. Grip frame: origin on the rope's axis at the middle of the jaw; u along the rope (the grip is symmetric in u), v outboard (the hanger and springs' side), w up. The hanger arm, its head, the guide roller and the arm's brackets belong to the hanger: they swing with it about the arm's axis (contract M3).

guards._guards: solid black rods lying along the top of the rope (owner 2026-10-21, the end-on photo; round 2: sleeves round the rope reached under it and cut every sheave)

crossbar._crossbar: joins the springs' top seats across the lever, under the top roller (round 2: it ran through the roller)
